    info=[band_shapes(b) for b in bands]
    # 3-bands: bands whose cells are all 3
    is3=[all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(b[0],b[1]+1) for c in range(w)) for b in bands]
    # restored shapes: for each 3-band, for each x-offset present in all other bands, restore there
    rest=[]
    for i,b in enumerate(bands):

    shapes=[]  # (anchor_row, anchor_col)

def transform(g):

    bands=[];cur=None
    for r in range(h):

            continue
        if any(g[r][c]==2 for c in range(w)):
            cur=[r,r] if cur is None else [cur[0],r]
        else:
            if cur: bands.append(tuple(cur)); cur=None
    if cur: bands.append(tuple(cur))
    bh=bands[0][1]-bands[0][0]+1
    top=g[bands[0][0]]
    xs=sorted({c for r in range(bands[0][0],bands[0][1]+1) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2})
    x0=[c for c in range(w) if top[c]==2 and (c==0 or top[c-1]==0)][0]
    lo=hi=x0
    allc=set(xs)
    while lo-1 in allc: lo-=1
    while hi+1 in allc: hi+=1
    cells=sorted((r-bands[0][0],c-x0) for r in range(bands[0][0],bands[0][1]+1) for c in range(lo,hi+1) if g[r][c]==2)
    def anchors(b):
        rr=g[b[0]]
        return [c for c in range(w) if rr[c]==2 and (c==0 or rr[c-1]==0)]
    ex=[anchors(b) for b in bands]
    # lattice units
    band_tops=[b[0] for b in bands]+[r0]
    band_tops.sort(); gap=min(b2-b1 for b1,b2 in zip(band_tops,band_tops[1:]))
    bunit={t:i for i,t in enumerate(band_tops)}
    offv=sorted({x for a in ex for x in a})
    osp=min((b2-b1) for b1,b2 in zip(offv,offv[1:])) if len(offv)>1 else 1
    ounit={x:(x-min(offv))//osp for x in offv}
    E={(bunit[b[0]],ounit[x]) for b,a in zip(bands,ex) for x in a}
    sb=bunit[r0]
    # candidate scoring
    best=None
    for u in sorted(ounit.values()):

        s1=1+sum(1 for (r,x) in E if r+x==p[0]+p[1])
        s2=1+sum(1 for (r,x) in E if r-x==p[0]-p[1])
        sc=max(s1,s2)
        key=(-sc,u)
        if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,p)
    rest=best[1]  # (band_unit, offset_unit)
    # map back: restored top row = r0 (strip top), x = offset unit -> actual x

    shapes=[(b[0],x) for b,a in zip(bands,ex) for x in a]
    shapes.append((r0,ux))
    shapes.sort()
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):

    for (dr,dc) in cells:

            dr,dc=cells[i]
            rr,cc=r+dr,x+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=8
    if vertical: out=T(out)
    return out
